name: video-clipper
description: Analyze source videos locally, pitch timestamped vertical Short ideas, and produce reviewed highlights or narrated Shorts with face tracking, Arabic word-highlight captions, and Egyptian ASR tuning.

interface.shortDescription: Review Short ideas and produce approved vertical clips locally
interface.longDescription: Analyze source videos locally with Whisper, OpenCV YuNet face tracking, and FFmpeg; pitch timestamped vertical Short ideas for selection; then render reviewed highlights or narrated Shorts with Arabic word-highlight captions.
defaultPrompt: Use $video-clipper to review my video and pitch timestamped ideas for me to choose.
